{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Aristotle Central Pipeline''' is a proposed natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/77b2a87d-f278-4ccf-9c9e-6ff01c0adfb5|title=oilandgaswatch.org|website=oilandgaswatch.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.williams.com/expansion-project/socrates-power-solution-facilities/|title=williams.com|website=williams.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline is proposed to run from Socrates North power plant, New Albany, Ohio to Socrates South power plant, New Albany, Ohio.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oilandgaswatch.org/pipeline/77b2a87d-f278-4ccf-9c9e-6ff01c0adfb5|title=oilandgaswatch.org|website=oilandgaswatch.org|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
